visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens outdoors at night against a metal fence. A young man with glasses and a green shirt points upward while a second man in the same shirt reacts with exaggerated shock, eventually gaining a checkered paper 'ear' overlay. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor living room with warm lighting. The man with glasses sits on a grey couch, while the second man wears a bald cap and fake mustache, gesturing as they speak. (3) A series of close-ups feature food and beverage products: a hand opens a burger bun to reveal a runny egg yolk, followed by a lineup of five wine bottles on a black marble table. (4) The man in the glasses holds and presents a bottle of Ségla red wine. A variety of snack bags, including shrimp crackers and marshmallows, are shown spread across the table. (5) Back in the living room, the man with the bald cap laughs heartily before covering his head with a folded newspaper. The video concludes with a final close-up of the runny egg burger.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 指月亮耳朵會被割掉？ [Subtitle]: 欸 今天月亮好大喔. [Slogan]: 禁止酒駕 🔞 未滿18歲禁止飲酒. (2) [Subtitle]: 欸 白癡喔. (3) [Subtitle]: 耳朵會被割掉. (4) [Subtitle]: 來不及了. (5) [Subtitle]: 欸 那怎麼辦？ (6) [Subtitle]: 不是啊 你耳朵不是被割掉了嗎 還聽得到我說話. (7) [Subtitle]: 喔 有字幕啊. (8) [Subtitle]: 可是我只要看到 圓圓亮亮的東西 手就會不受控很想指. (9) [Subtitle]: 不要再指月亮了 趕快跟我走 不然你耳朵被割完之後還會再被割什麼. (10) [Subtitle]: 不能指月亮 那要怎麼辦. (11) [Subtitle]: 不然指 那個阿伯的禿頭好了. (12) [Subtitle]: 啊 那個阿伯的禿頭 好像天上的月亮似的. (13) [Subtitle]: 我看倒有點像稿紙. (14) [Subtitle]: 真像7-ELEVEN 月見中秋饗宴. (15) [Subtitle]: 月見起司豬排堡 爆蛋流心豬肉堡 爆蛋流心豬肉堡的蛋黃 一位綽號叫「大食客」的同學說. (16) [Subtitle]: 啊 真的很像. (17) [Subtitle]: 賞月時 就是要喝酒吧. (18) [Subtitle]: 剛好7-ELEVEN可以預購 2017年份 瑞湖賽勒勒城堡紅酒. (19) [Subtitle]: 喝起來有黑櫻桃、黑莓派 和野生藍莓氣息. (20) [Subtitle]: 口感有漿果的風味 尾韻平衡！ (21) [Subtitle]: 還有2013年超級限量款！ (22) [Subtitle]: 還有美國-達歐莊園酒系列 的紅白酒都很讚. (23) [Subtitle]: 特別是夏多娜白酒 口感飽滿且滑順 帶有梨子、甜瓜 奇異果的細緻口感 很適合搭配 陳年起司等料理. (24) [Subtitle]: 喝好酒配上炸烤大對決系列的「零食、棉花糖、燒酒」也很搭！ (25) [Subtitle]: 我們不禁哄堂大笑 同樣的一顆禿頭 每個人卻有不同的感覺. (26) [Subtitle]: 那位阿伯 連忙把禿頭用紙包好 他覺得禿頭就是禿頭 不是月亮 也不是稿紙 更不是7-ELEVEN 月見中秋饗宴.
